facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine north of Brandonsford back to Warwick the smith, in exchange for his loan of the mithril chain shirt; Warwick keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre to use against his night visitors while they are gone.
The party must return Warwick's mithril chain shirt, his grandfather's armor, to him; Warwick holds the party's plate armor as collateral until it is returned.
Wayman Tisdale wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan, over his leather armor; it greatly improves his protection and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.
A natural-looking cave-in seals the Dwarven mine entrance, blocking the metal Warwick needs; it can be dug through, and Dunk had partly broken into it when a dead dwarf's arm emerged.
